17"""FlagGems ``mH``: the zero-copy conjugate-transpose view of ``self``. 

18 

19``aten::mH(self)`` is a pure metadata/view operator. It swaps the last two 

20dimensions of ``self`` and toggles the *lazy* conjugate bit; nothing is 

21materialized and no element is read, moved or written. The result therefore 

22shares ``self``'s storage at ``self``'s storage offset, re-derives the strides 

23for the exchanged last-two dimensions (so non-contiguous, transposed, 

24column-strided and offset-window inputs are handled for free), and stays a view 

25of ``self``, so a write through the result is visible in ``self``. 

26 

27Contract points that drive the implementation: 

28 

29* **Never materialize.** ``conj_physical`` / ``resolve_conj`` / ``clone`` / 

30 ``contiguous`` / ``to`` / any eager elementwise negation would break the 

31 shared-storage and ``is_conj()`` semantics. Only the lazy conjugating view 

32 (``Tensor.conj``) and the stride-exchange view (``Tensor.transpose``) are 

33 used -- the same primitives aten composes, and the composition reproduces 

34 aten's alias chain exactly (``out._base is self``) for real, complex, 

35 transposed, strided, offset and batched inputs. The shared 

36 ``_conjugate_transpose_view`` helper excludes the FlagGems backend key while 

37 toggling the bit, preventing the registered ``aten::_conj`` kernel from 

38 materializing a physical copy. 

39* **Conjugation is dtype-dependent.** The lazy conjugate bit only exists for 

40 complex dtypes; for a real tensor ``conj()`` is a no-op that hands back the 

41 very same object, so the rank >= 2 result is exactly ``transpose(-2, -1)``. 

42 Dispatching on ``is_complex()`` therefore removes a whole Tensor dispatch 

43 from every real-dtype call (11 of the 12 benchmarked dtypes) while producing 

44 byte-identical shape, strides, storage offset, storage pointer and 

45 ``is_conj()`` state; complex inputs keep the ``conj().transpose()`` chain. 

46* **Rank dispatch.** Rank >= 2 performs the transpose; rank 1 (including the 

47 empty ``(0,)`` tensor) is rejected with ``RuntimeError``; rank 0 is the 

48 deprecated path that warns (once per process, as aten does) and degrades to 

49 ``conj()`` (for a real tensor that returns the input object itself). 

50* **Grad flow.** ``conj`` and ``transpose`` are differentiable views, so the 

51 backward of ``mH`` is the same relayout applied to the upstream gradient. 

52 

53There is no elementwise domain, hence no device payload and no Triton kernel 

54launch: ``mH`` composes ``Tensor.conj`` and ``Tensor.transpose`` directly, and 

55the rank precondition is checked on the host exactly as aten does. (Round-1 

56profiling showed a rank-guard kernel launch was the whole measured cost -- 2 us 

57of device time per call on a pure metadata op -- so this revision drops it.) 

58 

59Host-path notes: the C-level ``Tensor`` descriptors are bound once at import 

60(no per-call bound-method creation) and real dtypes skip the no-op ``conj()`` 

61dispatch entirely, while complex inputs keep the exact lazy-conjugate chain 

62that aten builds. 

63""" 

64 

65import logging 

66import warnings 

67 

68import torch 

69 

70from flag_gems import runtime 

71 

72logger = logging.getLogger(__name__) 

73 

74__all__ = ["mH"] 

75 

76_MH_1D_MESSAGE = ( 

77 "tensor.mH is only supported on matrices or batches of matrices. " "Got 1-D tensor." 

78) 

79_MH_0D_MESSAGE = "Tensor.mH is deprecated on 0-D tensors. Consider using x.conj()." 

80 

81# aten emits its deprecation notice once per process; mirror that so the 0-D 

82# timing case does not pay the warnings machinery on every iteration. 

83_MH_WARN_STATE = {"warned": False} 

84 

85# Bind the C-level Tensor descriptors once: ``t.conj()`` otherwise pays a 

86# type-dictionary lookup plus a bound-method creation on every call. 

87_CONJ = torch.Tensor.conj 

88_TRANSPOSE = torch.Tensor.transpose 

89_IS_COMPLEX = torch.Tensor.is_complex 

90 

91# Parsing also resolves renamed PrivateUse1 keys such as MUSA. Both ``mH`` 

92# and ``matrix_H`` use this keyset through ``_lazy_conj`` so their view 

93# semantics stay identical under ``use_gems()``. 

94_BACKEND_KEYSET = torch._C.DispatchKeySet( 

95 torch._C._parse_dispatch_key(runtime.device.dispatch_key) 

96) 

97_EXCLUDE_BACKEND = torch._C._ExcludeDispatchKeyGuard 

98 

99 

100def _lazy_conj(self): 

101 """Toggle the lazy conjugate bit without entering FlagGems' ``_conj``. 

102 

103 FlagGems' device ``aten::_conj`` kernel materializes the conjugation. A 

104 conjugate-transpose view must instead preserve shared storage and the lazy 

105 bit, so redispatch the ``conj`` primitive with the backend key excluded. 

106 ``transpose`` remains outside this guard because its ``as_strided`` path 

107 needs the backend key. 

108 """ 

109 with _EXCLUDE_BACKEND(_BACKEND_KEYSET): 

110 return _CONJ(self) 

111 

112 

113def _conjugate_transpose_view( 

114 self, 

115 one_dim_message, 

116 zero_dim_message, 

117 warn_state, 

118 *, 

119 matrix_only=False, 

120): 

121 """Implement the shared rank and lazy-view contract for ``mH`` and ``H``.""" 

122 ndim = self.dim() 

123 if ndim == 1: 

124 raise RuntimeError(one_dim_message) 

125 if ndim == 0: 

126 # 0-D: deprecated aten path, warn once and degrade to conj(). 

127 if not warn_state["warned"]: 

128 warn_state["warned"] = True 

129 warnings.warn(zero_dim_message, UserWarning, stacklevel=3) 

130 return _lazy_conj(self) 

131 if matrix_only and ndim > 2: 

132 # Batches of matrices are aten::mH's domain, not aten::matrix_H's. 

133 raise RuntimeError( 

134 f"tensor.H is only supported on matrices (2-D tensors). Got {ndim}-D " 

135 "tensor. For batches of matrices, consider using tensor.mH" 

136 ) 

137 if _IS_COMPLEX(self): 

138 # Complex input: the lazy conjugate bit must be toggled as well. 

139 return _TRANSPOSE(_lazy_conj(self), -2, -1) 

140 # Real input: conj() is a no-op identity, so only exchange the strides. 

141 return _TRANSPOSE(self, -2, -1) 

142 

143 

144def mH(self): 

145 """Return the zero-copy conjugate-transpose view of ``self``.""" 

146 logger.debug("GEMS MH") 

147 return _conjugate_transpose_view( 

148 self, 

149 _MH_1D_MESSAGE, 

150 _MH_0D_MESSAGE, 

151 _MH_WARN_STATE, 

152 )
